content.text:
The drift failure occurred because the English API docs for `@pantoken/pendo` in [docs/api/renderers/pendo/src/index.md](docs/api/renderers/pendo/src/index.md) were recently updated with banner popover/survey description text, and Northern Sami (`se`) timed out during translation batching due to its low-resource character complexity under default timeout limits.

### Resolution
1. Ran the targeted API docs translation for the `se` locale with an extended timeout:
   ```sh
   cd docs && DOCS_TRANSLATION_LOCALE=se DOCS_TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 DOCS_TRANSLATION_ADAPTER=ai DOCS_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --effort low --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources user" node scripts/build-api-locales.ts
   ```
2. The translated string has been committed to [l10n/se/docs.api.po](l10n/se/docs.api.po).
3. Verified clean drift and parity status:
   - `node docs/scripts/check-locale-drift.ts` $\rightarrow$ `✓ @pantoken/docs: no translation drift`
   - `node docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts` $\rightarrow$ `✓ @pantoken/docs locale parity: no translation drift`
